caseNameFull: Fred W. Lake, in Error v. The Superior Court of the State of California in and for the County of Kern
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of California.
attorneys: Mr. James F. Peck and Mr. Charles C. Boynton for the plaintiffs in error. Mr. William J. Hunsaker, Mr. E. W. Britt, Mr. Frank H. Short and Mr. D. S. Ewing for the defendant in error.

opinions.text: Per Curiam. Dismissed for want of jurisdiction, upon the authority of No. 680, just decided, and authorities, there cited.
